description: Can someone fake (spoof) email from a domain? Reads SPF (counts the 10 DNS-lookup limit, follows includes), DMARC (policy, pct, reports, inherited from the parent domain) and DKIM keys (common selectors, or the one given), detects the email provider from MX, and returns a plain verdict (protected / partial / unprotected) plus the exact TXT records to add.

domain.description: Domain or email address, e.g. example.com or you@example.com

selector.description: Optional DKIM selector, e.g. google or selector1

name: check_email_security
